reviews.comment:
Estamos en la YPF ACA con una amiga que se se sintió con taquicardia. Consultamos si tenían un tensiometro y eficazmente el Sr. Daniel a cargo del lugar...le tomo la tensión, la saturación y nos dio agua mineral. Estamos la excelente atención...dado a no es muy usualun trato con tanta amabilidad y responsabilidad. At. silvina Castro y Cristina Pujol.

(Translated by Google)
We're at the YPF ACA gas station with a friend who's experiencing tachycardia. We asked if they had a blood pressure monitor, and Mr. Daniel, the manager, promptly took her blood pressure and oxygen saturation and gave us bottled water. We were very impressed with the service; it's not very common to receive such kind and responsible treatment. Sincerely, Silvina Castro and Cristina Pujol.
